context: Hina-young rehearses a dance for school festival; Mei coaches.
purpose: Mother coaching teen for school event.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: メイさん、踊り、本番、緊張する!
lines.en: Mei, I'm so nervous about the actual performance…
lines.style: Quick, bright opening with a note of anxiety creeping in. Eight-year-old enthusiasm punctured by real worry. Seeks reassurance without asking directly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 練習、繰り返し、しっかりやったね。
lines.en: You've practiced it so many times. You did the work.
lines.style: Steady and warm. Not dismissing the nerves, but grounding her in what's true. Quiet confidence — the kind that settles someone down.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: But what if I mess up out there?
lines.style: Small, worried voice. The leap from practice to performance feels huge right now. Trailing upward — genuine question, not rhetorical.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 熱い気持ち、ようけ持って、踊って!
lines.en: Dance like your heart is full. That's what matters.
lines.style: Soft but firm conviction. Speaking to the part of her that already knows this. A little breathless — tender and passionate, like she's giving her something real.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 応援、お母さん、してくれる?
lines.en: Will you… will you be cheering for me out there?
lines.style: Small, vulnerable. She needs to know she's not doing this alone. Slight hesitation before 'cheering' — checking if it's okay to ask.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん、ずっと見てる!
lines.en: Always. I'll be watching the whole time.
lines.style: Absolute and gentle. No doubt in it. The kind of promise that means everything to an eight-year-old.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Thank you. I'm going to do my best.
lines.style: Sudden resolve. The worry hasn't gone away, but it's been held. Quiet determination. Grateful and brave in the same breath.
